title: skills: objectstack-ui actions rule still teaches a param's helpText as a sentence only; it takes an inline locale map since objectstack#28266
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BvRcDHXqRU4TSVE4u6

Filing gate: **(b) a follow-up a PR names**. PR objectstack#31485 (closes #28266) declares `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`. `skills/**` is a Tier H surface, so that PR does not edit it. Dedup: searched open issues for "helpText skills actions.md"; no hits.

Serial: after objectstack#31485 lands. Do not teach the map before the schema accepts it.

## 维护者速读

动作参数的提示文字（`helpText`）在 #28266 之后可以写成按语言的对照表（`{ en: …, 'zh-CN': … }`），和 `label`、`description` 一样。技能文档 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` 第 25 行还只教「写一句话」。AI 照着技能写页面按钮的内联动作时，会把提示只写成一种语言。这张卡只改这一行附近的说明，属于 Tier H，需要维护者批准。

## Work

1. In `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` (the copy-holes line, currently line 25), say that a param's `helpText`, like `description`, takes either a sentence or an inline locale map. Say that the map is how a page button's inline `action`, which no bundle reaches, writes its hint per locale, and that holes (`{{ record.name }}`) work in either form.
2. If the skill has a worked example of an inline action, add `helpText` as a map there. Run the skill example checks (`check:skill-examples`).

## Done when

- The rule teaches both forms, matching `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` as #31485 left it, and the skill checks pass.

Priority: p3.
